Description: Establish, communicate, and maintain information security policy and governance.
Define and assign security roles, responsibilities, and authorities.
Establish and maintain an organizational risk management strategy.
Manage security risk from suppliers and external service providers.
Maintain an inventory of enterprise hardware assets.
Maintain an inventory of authorized software.
Classify and label data by sensitivity.
Assess cybersecurity risk to the organization.
Identify and document asset vulnerabilities.
Issue, manage, and revoke identities and credentials.
Authenticate users; enforce MFA for remote and privileged access.
Enforce least-privilege and manage access permissions.
Provide security awareness training to all users.
Provide specialized training for privileged/specialized roles.
Protect the confidentiality and integrity of data at rest.
Protect data in transit with encryption.
Manage cryptographic keys throughout their lifecycle.
Establish and enforce secure configuration baselines.
Identify, test, and apply software patches.
Deploy and maintain anti-malware protections.
Generate and retain audit logs for security events.
Protect network integrity via segmentation and boundary controls.
Protect against email- and web-borne threats.
Monitor networks and systems to detect adverse events.
Analyze events to understand attacks and detect incidents.
Establish and execute an incident response plan.
Report and communicate incidents to internal/external stakeholders.
Contain and eradicate incidents.
Create and protect backups of critical data.
Execute recovery to restore systems and data (RTO/RPO).
Coordinate restoration communications with stakeholders.
